request.notes: Simulation float64 (vw.World, jax.vmap, about 90k member-ticks, raw level 0 kept on the pod), encoders float32 on the GPU (78 configs x 4 replicas), certification on the pod CPUs (lphi.certify, one BLAS thread per worker). Training stops starting new configs 2 h after job start, certification 2.5 h; priority order puts c = 1 and the linear arm first. CPU smoke test passed: job.sh end to end at tiny size (B4_TINY=1) from a copy of exactly these paths.
request.purpose: Round-4 study bias (track 1): learned level 1 from raw gliders level 0, grid of encoder locality x latent width x objective (recon, closure, local law, predictive bottleneck), 2 seeds, certified by learned_phi2's fixed family
request.setup:
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH
uv venv -q -p 3.12 $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv && . $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -q 'jax[cuda12]==0.12.0.1' numpy==2.5.4 scipy==1.18.0
